:::{#hero-heading}

Wei Jin is an Assistant Professor at the Center for Transnational Studies and Institute of International Economics, School of Economics, Nankai University, Tianjin, China.

His research fields include international economics, international trade, and international business.

He received his Ph.D. from Singapore Management University in 2018, his M.S. from the University of Macau in 2013, and his B.A. from the Central University of Finance and Economics in 2011.

His research studies international trade, international economic integration, trade policy, and related topics in international business and economic development.

For more information, please see his [research page](publications.qmd), [contact page](contact.qmd), or original [personal website](https://weijinsite.weebly.com/){.external target="_blank"}.

:::
